name: Symbol of Ragnaros
summary: The Symbol of Ragnaros is a Twilight's Hammer relic found in Searing Gorge. Velarok seeks its foul magic to make a casing for the Torch of Retribution.

sections.title: Foul Magic
sections.body: Velarok Windblade needs a Symbol of Ragnaros for the Torch of Retribution. He believes the Twilight's Hammer encampment in the mountains northwest of here holds symbols and idols with power enough to form the torch's casing. The symbol's magic suits his purpose.

faq.q: What is the Symbol of Ragnaros?
faq.answer: It is a symbol carried by the Twilight's Hammer, and its magic can help form a casing for the Torch of Retribution.
Velarok Windblade needs the Symbol of Ragnaros to make the Torch of Retribution's casing.
Velarok hopes to extract its foul magic and use it to form a casing for the Torch of Retribution.
The Twilight's Hammer encampment in the mountains northwest of here is rumored to hold symbols and idols.
